fields.title: Research Assistant - Machine Learning
fields.description: We are looking for a motivated student to assist with our machine learning research project. You will help with data preprocessing, model training, and result analysis.
fields.qualifications:
- Currently enrolled in Computer Science or related field
- Strong programming skills in Python
- Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts
- Good analytical and problem-solving skills
- Fluent in English

fields.title: HiWi - Web Development Support
fields.description: Support needed for maintaining and developing our department's web applications. Tasks include frontend development, bug fixes, and documentation.
fields.qualifications:
- Experience with React and JavaScript
- Basic knowledge of Django/Python
- Git version control
- Self-motivated and reliable
- Available for at least 2 semesters

fields.title: Mathematics Tutor
fields.description: Looking for a student to provide tutoring support for first-year mathematics courses. You will help students understand calculus and linear algebra concepts.
fields.qualifications:
- Excellent grades in mathematics courses
- Patient and good at explaining complex concepts
- Previous tutoring experience preferred
- Available during evening hours

fields.title: Administrative Assistant - International Office
fields.description: Help with administrative tasks in the International Office. Duties include data entry, document preparation, and supporting international students.
fields.qualifications:
- Fluent in German and English
- Proficient in MS Office
- Organized and detail-oriented
- Good communication skills
- Experience with intercultural communication is a plus

fields.title: Lab Assistant - Electronics Workshop
fields.description: Assist in the electronics laboratory with equipment maintenance, student supervision, and workshop preparation.
fields.qualifications:
- Background in Electrical Engineering or similar
- Hands-on experience with electronic components
- Safety-conscious approach
- Good German language skills
